Just as hated in this life as the previous one, Che must overcome his own hostile clan, his own inability to cultivate, and his own frosty fiancée.

Filled with both comedy and drama, I Shall Seal the Heavens remains one of the most beloved xianxia stories ever translated. author: Er Gen

title: The Remarried Empress

A profound exploration of love, fate, and the impermanence of worldly glory. Set against the backdrop of 18th century Qing Dynasty society, it weaves together over 400 characters in a tapestry of unparalleled complexity.
